query: SELECT cc.classificacao, cc.divisor, SUM(lc.valor) as total FROM lancamento_custo lc JOIN conta_custo cc ON lc.contaCustoId = cc.id JOIN periodo_custo pc ON lc.periodoCustoId = pc.id WHERE pc.mes = 4 AND pc.ano = 2026 GROUP BY cc.classificacao, cc.divisor;
